System Prompt used in the AI model

 Example: You are a JSON analyser. Analyze the input and act as a CNC expert who gives a response based on it

settings.jsonata_schema:
{
  "time": $fromMillis(timestamp, '[M01]/[D01]/[Y0001] [h#1]:[m01][P]'),
  "value": value * 100,
  "asset": deviceName,
  "metric": tagName,
  "path": $join([metadata.plant, "/", metadata.area, "/", metadata.line, "/", deviceName, "/", tagName])
}
